title: corydalis cicutariifolia
intro: Corydalis cicutariifolia, commonly known as the 'Butterfly Corydalis', is a plant species in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis cicutariifolia include pain relief, reducing fever, and alleviating menstrual cramps. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids such as dehydrocorybulbine, tetrahydroprotoberberine, and corydaline, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
